# import-jobs commands

| Command | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `data` | Get the raw XML data for an import job |
| `get` | Get details for a specific import job |
| `list` | List import jobs in the environment |
| `url` | Get the Maker portal URL for an import job |
| `wait` | Wait for an import job to complete |
